TITLE: Dyson Prismatic Lotus
DESCRIPTION: Raymarched 3D sacred-geometry crystal lotus floating above a rippling black-mirror mercury pool with a true 1-bounce planar reflection, Snell's-law RGB dispersion, Beer-Lambert jewel absorption, and caustic shafts. Features 12 live-wired controls across 4 UI groups, 5 factory presets, and a deterministic beat-synced QuickJS script.

CONTROLS.NAME: speed
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Bipolar petal rotation and camera orbit tempo; negative values reverse the lotus counter-spin.

CONTROLS.NAME: audioDrive
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Scales FFT bass, mid, and high coupling into petal breathing, core heart flare, and pool caustics.

CONTROLS.NAME: bloomFold
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Opens or closes the three concentric crystal lotus petal tiers from tight bud to full sacred bloom.

CONTROLS.NAME: poolRipple
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Amplitude of concentric mercury-pool mirror ripples distorting the planar reflection.

CONTROLS.NAME: kaleidoMirror
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Engages vertical-axis sacred mirror reflection across the viewport for symmetrical stage totems.

CONTROLS.NAME: dispersion
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Snell's-law RGB refractive-index separation inside the crystal lotus petals.

CONTROLS.NAME: causticGlow
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Intensity of volumetric core halo shafts and golden-cyan mercury pool caustics.

CONTROLS.NAME: accentTint
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Shifts the thin-film crystal iridescence and core caustic chromatic palette.

CONTROLS.NAME: intensity
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Master HDR exposure into ACES filmic tone mapping.

CONTROLS.NAME: invertFlash
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Inverts crystal luminance into a high-contrast photographic negative solarized prism look.

CONTROLS.NAME: energyFlash
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Momentary Dyson-core harmonic flare sending a radial caustic ring across the mercury pool.

CONTROLS.NAME: orbit
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: 2D camera azimuth (X) and elevation (Y) orbiting above the black-mirror mercury pool.

PRESETS.NAME: Default
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Balanced crystalline lotus in sapphire-cyan light above a gently rippling mercury mirror.

PRESETS.NAME: Deep Warehouse
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Tightly folded obsidian bud with slow reverse spin, heavy mercury waves, and sub-bass core reactivity.

PRESETS.NAME: Peak-Time Strobe
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Wide-open sacred bloom with symmetrical kaleido mirror, maximum RGB refraction, and blazing core caustics.

PRESETS.NAME: Iridescent Dream
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: High-elevation meditative orbit over a glass-still mercury mirror with lush pastel thin-film refraction.

PRESETS.NAME: Sub-Bass Minimal
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Architectural closed crystal totem with restrained caustics, low ripple, and warm amber-gold core highlights.
